description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mahiella, Mallawapitiya D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420222 (24/0314)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (Parcel No. 200 and Parcel No. 81) with detailed property information including ownership details, extent, location, encumbrances, and title classifications. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it concerns land registration, property ownership, and title settlement matters.
